Oh Jong-Hyuk

Introduction

Click-B was a seven-member South Korean boy band formed by Daesung Entertainment (later known as DSP Media). The group debuted in 1999 with their first studio album, Click-B 1st.

In 2002, members Yoo Ho-suk, Ha Hyun-gon, and No Min-hyuk departed from the group, leading to lineup changes in subsequent releases.

In September 2015, it was announced that Click-B would reunite with all seven original members for a special project. On October 21, 2015, they released their first single album in over a decade, Reborn. The group followed the release with their reunion concert, 7-3=7, held on November 20, 2015.
